baselineOracle.method: render representative rows with OpenTUI testRender and freeze captureSpans

stableOracle.reason: The pinned stable tree predates the baseline's focused DiffMetaRowView extraction; stable-only behavior remains covered by its owning older renderer and the enumerated stable-fix queue.

nativeAdaptation.rendering: The OpenTUI boxes become one fully width-filled renderer-neutral line projected directly into Ratatui cells.
nativeAdaptation.hover: The row's hover callback becomes PaintedDiffMetaRow.row_key for host hit testing.
nativeAdaptation.nestedActions: Gap and add-note mouse handlers become disjoint DiffMetaGapToggleHit and CodeRowAddNoteHit terminal-column ranges, so the host dispatches the nested action before the enclosing row.
nativeAdaptation.paddingForeground: OpenTUI reports its framework-default white foreground on background-only trailing spaces. Ratatui retains Color::Reset for those semantically unpainted foreground cells while matching their content, width, and panel-alt background.

sourceCoverage.destination: native metadata-row options plus renderer and nested-hit result vocabulary
all upstream props represented as shell state or returned row, hover, gap, and add-note metadata
static and expandable collapsed labels, separately styled badge, clipped reserved area, and host-owned nested actions
hunk-header visibility, badge geometry, Unicode-safe fitting, selected rail paint, metadata label palette, width fill, and action projection
